sentences.en: Please return one set to us with your signature.
sentences.zh: 请用你的签名把一份寄给我们。

sentences.en: I still can't believe that you forged her signature.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信你伪造了她的签名。

sentences.en: "Takatukaland" is a nice mnemonic for a five-four time signature: Takatukalantakatukalantakatukaland...
sentences.zh: "塔卡图兰德"这个口诀可以帮助记住四四拍的记谱法：塔卡图兰德塔卡图兰德塔卡图兰德……

senses.zh: 签名,署名,识别标志，鲜明特征,医药的用法说明
